name: Eyes of Rain
source:
As a humble baker in a quiet medieval town, your life takes a dark turn when a stranger arrives equipped for battle. Thrust into a hidden world of supernatural beings—elves, demons, fae, and more—you must make choices that alter the fate of the world you thought you knew.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3272510/Eyes_of_Rain/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
作为一个安静的中世纪小镇里的一名不起眼的面包师，当一个陌生人带着战斗装备到来时，你的生活发生了黑暗的转变。闯入一个充满超自然生物（精灵、恶魔、仙灵等等）的隐秘世界，你必须做出选择，改变你自以为了解的世界的命运。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3272510/Eyes_of_Rain/]Steam[/url]]
